title: pvOctreeImagetoPointSet
body:
## pvOctreeImagetoPointSet

Reverses pvPointSetToOctreeImage: reads an image whose cell scalars are the unsigned-char "octree" bit mask and emits polydata with one point for every set bit, placed at the centre of the corresponding octant of the cell (a quarter of the spacing from the cell centre). It can also copy one component of a chosen cell array to the generated points. Use it to rebuild an approximate point cloud from a compact octree image; positions are quantized to octants, so original coordinates are not recovered.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The active cell scalars must be the unsigned-char octree mask produced by pvPointSetToOctreeImage (array "octree"); other images give meaningless points.
- pvPointSetToOctreeImage outputs a partitioned dataset holding one image; if this filter rejects it, extract the image block first.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `OctreeImagetoPointSet`. Identity: `filters/OctreeImageToPointSet`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

Accepted data: image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
